review_type: Author editorial and numerical review; not independent university certification

reviewed.reasoning: Choice comparisons, unit bases, stocks and flows, payment timing, uncertainty, conditional counts, financial claims and causal interpretations checked against each chapter's assumptions.
reviewed.arithmetic: Determinate worked examples and exercise results independently recomputed in scripts/verify.py; project recomputed through its separate transaction engine.
reviewed.solutions: Every chapter has eight solutions or evaluation criteria corresponding to its exact questions. Open choices are graded by explicit reasoning rather than a forced recommendation.
reviewed.instruction: Prerequisites and new notation are introduced. The quadratic formula needed for the rate-solving exercise was added explicitly. Advanced methods are identified as later extensions rather than required for unprepared learners.
reviewed.sources: General foundational relationships are original instructional synthesis. The source catalogue provides verified official further-reading routes. Specific CPI and money-creation references distinguish official measurement/conceptual discussion from synthetic examples and dated operating rules.
reviewed.structure: Two worked examples and eight exercises per chapter, teach-back and delayed checks, outcome metadata and functioning internal links verified. All numerical cases are explicitly illustrative where applicable.
reviewed.assessment_package: Diagnostic, separate 100-point Forms A/B, solutions/scoring, project inputs, benchmark code, rubric, oral examination, retention and remediation provided. Exam and project arithmetic checked.
